name: onnxruntime-web
description: In-repo stub. @huggingface/transformers declares onnxruntime-web as a dependency but its prebuilt Node bundle (transformers.node.mjs) replaces the import with an empty module at webpack-build time (`onnxruntime-web (ignored)`). We only run on Node, so the upstream 90MB package is never loaded — this stub satisfies pnpm install without shipping the bytes. See package.json `pnpm.overrides`.
